champion.tips: MILIO TIPS AND TRICKS Abuse your range against melee champions to gain health leads in the lane. It will be highly beneficial if you keep auto-attacking them often. Stay away from your team in team fights so you can use your Ultimate to save them from CC. Stay with them but behind them so you can empower them. Whenever you have your empowered autos up, make sure you auto-attack the enemy as soon as possible.
champion.builds: THE BEST MILIO BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR SUPPORT IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Milio Support build, you should take Flash and Heal as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Summon Aery as your keystone, followed by Manaflow Band, Transcendence and Scorch in the primary tree, as well as Bone Plating and Revitalize in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Ability Haste in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Dream Maker as your first item, followed by Ionian Boots of Lucidity and Echoes of Helia. For your last 3 items, you should build Moonstone Renewer, Redemption and finish with Vigilant Wardstone. For the skill order, you want to stick with E - W - Q. Right now, this build has 52.7% winrate over 51 794 matches played. Optional Your second option for Milio Support build would be to take Flash and Heal as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Guardian as your keystone, Font of Life, Bone Plating and Revitalize in the primary tree, and Biscuit Delivery with Cosmic Insight in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense. The items for the build are Dream Maker, which you should build first, followed by Ionian Boots of Lucidity as your second item and Echoes of Helia as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Moonstone Renewer, Redemption and Ardent Censer. The skill order for this build is E - W - Q. In the current patch, this build has a 52.0% win rate over 2 458 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Heal as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Summon Aery as your keystone, Manaflow Band, Transcendence and Scorch in the primary tree, and Bone Plating with Revitalize in the secondary tree, as well as Ability Haste, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Celestial Opposition as your first item, then Ionian Boots of Lucidity as a second item and Echoes of Helia as a third item. You want to finish the build with Moonstone Renewer, Redemption and Dawncore. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it E - W - Q. This build is currently sitting at a 50.5% win rate across 1 696 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Milio Support build in the current patch, try Flash and Heal as your Summoner Spells, Dark Harvest, Cheap Shot, Deep Ward and Treasure Hunter as your primary rune tree, and Revitalize with Bone Plating as your secondary tree. Use Ability Haste, Adaptive Force and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Dream Maker as your first item, then finish Ionian Boots of Lucidity as your second item, and Echoes of Helia as third item. The last 3 options are Moonstone Renewer, Redemption and Dawncore. The ability order for this build is E - W - Q. As of the current patch, this build has a 53.2% win rate over 310 matches played. Situational Milio Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Milio build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Milio runes page.
